automation_and_security.name: CISA Shai-Hulud npm supply chain alert
automation_and_security.description: CISA September 2025 alert on the Shai-Hulud self-replicating worm affecting 500+ npm packages; establishes minimumReleaseAge and token hygiene as primary mitigations

automation_and_security.name: Microsoft Security: dependency confusion npm attack May 2026
automation_and_security.description: May 2026 Microsoft Security Blog on 33 malicious npm packages abusing dependency confusion via org-scoped namespace mimicry; scope allowlists and private registry enforcement as mitigations

automation_and_security.name: pnpm 11 release announcement
automation_and_security.description: pnpm 11 (April 2026): requires Node.js 22, pure ESM, SQLite store, tighter supply-chain defaults including approve-builds and onlyBuiltDependencies changes

automation_and_security.name: pnpm 12 (native Rust port)
automation_and_security.description: pnpm 12: native Rust port, installed via `pnpm self-update` from pnpm 11.10+; supersedes the pnpm 11 ESM/SQLite release as the current major as of July 2026

automation_and_security.name: npm v12 security overhaul
automation_and_security.description: npm 12 (shipping July 2026): disables install scripts, git dependencies, and remote-URL dependencies by default; accelerated timeline follows repeated 2026 npm namespace-takeover incidents

automation_and_security.name: Miasma npm supply chain compromise
automation_and_security.description: June 2026: compromise of the @redhat-cloud-services npm namespace (32 packages), followed by a 'Phantom Gyp' technique hitting 57 more packages in a 2-hour window; directly accelerated npm v12's default-deny release
